; Synthetic zone for example.com (RFC 2606 reserved name).
; Used to reason about record shapes without querying anyone's infrastructure.
; The SPF record is split across two character-strings exactly as a DNS provider
; might store it, which is why the checker and the skill both insist on reading
; the raw presentation format rather than a joined one-line view.

$ORIGIN example.com.
$TTL 300

@       IN  TXT  "v=spf1 ip4:192.0.2.10 ip4:192.0.2.11 "
@       IN  TXT  "include:_spf.provider.example ~all"
@       IN  MX   10 mx1.example.com.
@       IN  MX   20 mx2.example.com.

_dmarc  IN  TXT  "v=DMARC1; p=none; sp=none; pct=100; adkim=r; aspf=r; rua=mailto:dmarc@example.com"

mail._domainkey      IN  TXT  "v=DKIM1; k=rsa; "
old._domainkey       IN  TXT  "v=DKIM1; k=rsa; p="
2023._domainkey      IN  CNAME  selector1.provider.example.

; Subdomain used by a marketing ESP. No SPF record of its own; DMARC is inherited
; from the organizational domain, where sp=none applies.
news    IN  TXT  "v=spf1 include:_spf.provider.example -all"

; Staging label that still points a selector at a provider the owner no longer uses.
staging._domainkey   IN  CNAME  old-tenant.mailgun.org.
